# Business Travel and Expense Policy

## Booking

All domestic flights must be booked through the company travel desk at least 14 days before travel. Economy class is the default for all employees.
Business class is allowed only for international flights longer than 8 hours and needs Vice President approval.

## Hotel Limits

| City tier | Nightly hotel limit (INR) | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 7,500 | Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai |
| Tier 2 | 5,000 | Coimbatore, Pune, Jaipur, Kochi |
| Tier 3 | 3,000 | All other cities |

## Daily Allowance

Employees receive a daily allowance of INR 1,200 for food and local travel on domestic trips. No receipts are needed for the daily allowance.

## Expense Claims

Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of returning from the trip, with original receipts for every item above INR 500.
Claims submitted after 60 days are rejected. Approved claims are reimbursed in the next salary cycle.

## Mileage

Use of a personal car for business is reimbursed at INR 12 per kilometre; two-wheelers at INR 5 per kilometre.
